title: Moonlit night
description: A silver moon high in the south-east, deep blue sky, blue-grey ambient so shapes still read, dark blue fog. Add warm point lights (windows, lanterns) for contrast.
derived_from: kit/style/iamar/style.json atmosphere.presets.night (mp_look.gd LOOKS.night). Uses sun.direction for the moon because time_of_day 21.5 alone gives the sun zero energy in a package.
